text:
deploy-bot: promotion blocked — artifact signing returned 503 from signer.service.internal while uploading image registry.redwood.io/releases/canary-2026-03-23. staging smoke: 1/3 int tests failed (db-seed timeout). holding promotion.

maria: on it, checking signer logs and rate limits. any recent deploys to signer?

jon: fyi the signer has been throttling for larger multipart uploads, seen it earlier today. can we retry smaller chunk size?

liz: small-chunk workaround exists but it's a risky change during promote. prefer pin-to-last-good if we need to unblock quickly.

sam: i'm oncall — i'll try a restart on the signer cluster and requeue the artifact upload. rerunning signer pod now.

platform-bot: restart initiated by sam at 1748202530. healthcheck in progress.

sam: healthcheck passed on leader but one worker shows high 5xx rate. digging.

deploy-bot: retry attempt #1: upload still returning intermittent 503 for the same artifact.

maria: logs show the 503s correlate to S3 multipart part commit latency spike. storage team alerted — they reported a short region-wide latency spike 12 minutes ago.

jon: Given this, options: 1) wait for storage to stabilize and retry (risk delay), 2) pin to last-good digest and manual promote under change window, 3) rerun pipeline repeatedly until signer succeeds. Thoughts?

liz: I'm leaning to option 2. pin last-good image digest (sha256:abc123def) and create an incident-rollout note. Keep canary traffic low and schedule manual promote in the 2pm-4pm change window if storage is stable by then.

sam: agreed. i'm happy to approve manual promote if signer stable in the window. For now hold promotion and update release notes.

maria: command to pin: `deploy-bot pin-image registry.redwood.io/releases/canary@sha256:abc123def --reason "signer 503"` — will run after ops confirm storage.

deploy-bot: noted. promotion status: HELD. will not auto-promote.

jon: also let's add a postmortem ticket and include the reproduction steps + signer multipart tuning followup. I'll open the ticket and link to the thread.

liz: adding to release notes: "Canary promotion delayed due to artifact signing failures; pinned to last-known-good image. Customers not impacted at this time."

sam: final: hold until 14:00 PT change window. if signer healthy by 13:50 PT we can retry and auto-promote; otherwise manual promote to pinned digest or rollback depending on validation.

deploy-bot: acknowledged. holding and logging decision. :white_check_mark:
